BELAHA (real name Serhii Bielashko).
Was born on September 30, 1987 in Sumy, Ukraine.
Dj and producer. He has been being fond of music since his school-day's. Studing in colledge he attempted to ompose his own music. In spring 2007 the first album of his band, named Linnem Absor, appeared and was called "Invention". It contained 9 compositions and 3 remixes. In autumn 2007 our second and the last album, called "Peoples Of The Broadcast" appeared.
Since the dj Belaha became the resident of the greatest parties in the city clubs and open-air parties.
In spring 2008 his EP album Dreams appeared. It cotained 4 compositions of different electronic directions, and soundet the voicesof the young talanted peoples from Sumy.
Belaha's tracks, remixes and mashups constantly come upon the play-lists of the top DJs and sound in couples of clubs in Ukraine.
From January 2011 he carries on his author's radio-show "Hypnotic Trance", broadcasts on the greatest radio stations of Ukraine.
Now Belaha creates new tracks and remixes, carries on an active club activity, takes part in couples of events and festivals.

KLAID has released music on respected labels such as Steyoyoke, EINMUSIKA, ICONYC and Cafe De Anatolia, with standout tracks like Absinthe, Enzyme, and Dadirri. His collaborations include work with Mila Journee and support from artists like Einmusika, Nick Devon, Mitch de Klein, and Alessio Penatti.

From Soundcheck club to Flash to Culture [DC], KLAID’s performances deliver immersive, soul-stirring experiences that resonate far beyond the dancefloor.

I am an electronic dance music dj producer/remixer and DJ mix playlist/album creator focusing on chill deep house, melodic deep tech,  tropical house, and vocal edm for parties and working out.  

Here you'll find electronic dance music and DJ Mix playlists with electronic dance music with no gaps and now leaning to shorter 3 minute lengths so you don't get bored in the mix.  Add songs to your favorite playlists or free download it's up to you!  Also for the DJs are Extended Club Remix Free Download (Top search result) songs for your DJ Mix Set!  Thank you.  

Greg Sletteland

I LOVE making music and you will find a blend of Maxim Mag meets Electronic Dance Music!  There are 900+ original tracks & remixes for free download for DJ club, mobile, radio, and personal use.  I hope you find the songs helpful =) 

Grateful to our diehard listeners, Greg Sletteland (San Francisco, USA), MC Freeflow (London, UK), & Giulia Mihai (Ploiesti, Romania) broke through Apple Music with two #1 Apple Music Albums -- #1 2017 2016 Tech House Albums (Spring 2017 Miami & DJ Top 100 Chart Best EDM: 2016) & #4 Album 2017 House (DJ Has Arrived) featuring songs including DJ Is Spinning (Apple Music #1 2017 Ibiza song, #2 2017 House Song), I Love You In My Dreams Feat. Giulia Mihai (Apple Music #1 2017 Tropical House), & It's Party Time Feat. MC Freeflow (Apple Music #3 2017 House Song).  

DJ Has Arrived album is an uplifting chill house music album while the new Ibiza Pride DJ series of albums are a bit more big room tropical house.   

2018 was a great year breaking through on Amazon as #2 DJ search result music album Ibiza Pride DJ: Miami 2018 and on Apple Music Sexy Deep House 2019 reached #1 2019 Electronic Dance Music search result.

2019 is a new year with Soundcloud focusing on the DJ Mix playlist with 3 minute electronic dance music (many free download for the mobile DJ and radio DJ) with no intro outro gaps.  For the club and festival DJs special Extended Club Remix are available top search result.

Greg Sletteland's love of music was inspired by his mom getting piano lessons for him in elementary school and orchestra class in middle school in San Francisco.  Listening to DJ mixes on Saturday night radio he bought as much records as he could from Tower Records and was in his first DJ battle in San Francisco judged by DJ QBert in 1990 vs DJ Dino and was voted #3 DJ of 1,000+ DJ’s at that time in South Korea by Juliana Dance Magazine.  Later, DJ Greg started a Mix show on Radio Korea Los Angeles featuring the top 7 songs of the week with co host Lee Ki Sang. 

Greg Sletteland then founded the worlds largest record pool at the time with 1,400 DJ members.  This Soundcloud page is like a record pool with free download radio and club Remixes focused on the DJ.

Like Armin Van Buuren, Greg Sletteland has a legal background and practiced law for 5 years.

In love with the music and inspired by the touch screen interface of musical instruments on iPad mini and by analyzing the midi files of great artists, he started creating countless songs on Steinberg Cubasis which is still his favorite way to create music.   Songs are also produced using Cubase & and latest reFx Nexus on the fastest MacBook available using EV 15" Speakers to ensure club playability!  

Hope to play for you soon at a club or festival near you!  Thank you for listening to the music! And hope to see you on Instagram.  I follow back  music artist DJs there.

Much love!
Greg Sletteland

user.description:
Raumdekor ist ein leidenschaftlicher DJ und Produzent für House- und Tech-House-Musik mit einem besonderen Fokus auf den richtigen Groove. Seine musikalische Reise begann Ende der 2000er-Jahre, als er auf Geburtstags- und Hauspartys mit Vinyl-Platten auflegte.

2013 gründete er in seiner Heimatstadt auf der Insel Rügen die Partyreihe “House for Friends”, um Menschen abseits des Mainstreams eine Plattform für elektronische Musik zu bieten. Drei Jahre lang brachte dieses Projekt unvergessliche Erlebnisse, bevor es mit vielen schönen Erinnerungen endete. Zu dieser Zeit lebte Raumdekor bereits seit einigen Jahren in Berlin und tauchte tiefer in die dortige elektronische Musikszene ein.

2019 startete er das Projekt “Urban Smile”, eine Partyreihe in der RADIO - The Label Bar Berlin. Die Veranstaltungen waren sowohl bei Freunden als auch bei Gästen beliebt und lieferten wertvolle Impulse für die Berliner Musikszene. Mit der Schließung der Bar endete auch dieses Projekt.

Ebenfalls in 2019 organisierte Raumdekor das erste Open Air mit dem Namen “Lass Dich Tanzen.“ Diese atemberaubende Open-Air-Party am Spreeufer im Herzen Berlins war der Beginn von etwas Größerem. Heute ist „Lass Dich Tanzen.“ zu einem Kollektiv talentierter Künstler und DJs herangewachsen und schafft einen Freiraum für alle, die exklusive Events lieben, welche Kunst, Menschen und Musik in Berlin zusammenbringt.

—————————————————————————
English:

Raumdekor is a passionate DJ and producer of House and Tech House music, with a strong focus on creating the perfect groove. His musical journey began in the late 2000s when he started playing vinyl at birthday and house parties.

In 2013, he founded the party series “House for Friends” in his hometown on the island of Rügen. This project provided a platform for electronic music, offering people an alternative to mainstream events. Over three years, the series created countless unforgettable memories before coming to an end. By that time, Raumdekor had already been living in Berlin for a few years, immersing himself more deeply in the city’s vibrant electronic music scene.

In 2019, he launched “Urban Smile”, a party series hosted at RADIO - The Label Bar Berlin. The project quickly gained popularity among friends and visitors, contributing valuable energy to Berlin’s music culture. Unfortunately, the project came to an end with the closure of the venue.

Also in 2019, Raumdekor organized the first open-air event under the name “Lass Dich Tanzen.” This stunning open-air party, held along the banks of the Spree in the heart of Berlin, was the beginning of something greater. Today, “Lass Dich Tanzen.” has grown into a collective of talented artists and DJs, creating a free space for everyone who loves exclusive events that bring together art, people, and music in Berlin.

E-Mail/ Contact: mathias_czekay@web.de
